# Elyx

> Elyx Life is Singapore's first concierge longevity service — an always-on intelligence layer that turns healthspan ambition into measurable progress. Medical expertise is provided through Elyx Medical, a preferred licensed medical partner.

Elyx convenes and orchestrates a curated network of physicians and experts around each member, combining tailored information, technology, science, medical guidance, physiological support, and concierge execution into one annual membership built around the individual.
